subtitle: One control, letting a viewer swap what an entire view is built on

caption: A String, List parameter whose values are measure names: Discount, Profit, Quantity, Sales.
Two selector controls — any pair of measures, one scatter plot, zero extra worksheets.

code:
CASE [Placeholder 1 Selector]
WHEN "Discount" THEN SUM([Discount])
WHEN "Profit"   THEN SUM([Profit])
WHEN "Quantity" THEN SUM([Quantity])
WHEN "Sales"    THEN SUM([Sales])
END
caption: The parameter names a measure; this CASE calculation returns its actual value.
